skill.name: design
skill.description: Executes visual design with quantified rules for hierarchy, spacing grids, type scale, color contrast, and layout. Use when designing or critiquing UI screens, slides, graphics, posters, or documents, or when choosing fonts and palettes without a design system.
skill.summary: When To Use - Designing any visual artifact from scratch: UI screens, landing pages, slides, social graphics, posters, PDFs. - Fixing a design that "looks off" when the user cannot articulate why. - Choosing typography,
